description: Northstar OS subscription plan catalog — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. v4 (V3 shell, 2026-10-18) adds `ui_gates`: UI-SURFACE capabilities (e.g. advanced_view, the dev-level room shell). ui_gates are presentation/routing only — they never arm a live/paid action, which is why gates_always_off (applies to live gates) stays true. v3 (Phase H/H6) set DISPLAY NAMES, PRICES, and service coverage to the frozen alpha ladder (Whetstone/Mainstay/Keystone/AutothinK at 39/79/129/179). Plan ids remain stable (foundation/scout/mover/autothink) per the naming scope rule — display labels are cosmetic; ids, gate ids, and routes do not change until a scheduled revision. Entitled (live) gate arrays are UNCHANGED from v2: a plan never flips a live gate; every live action additionally requires a fresh, named operator approval per action. Per-tier action caps live in shared/usage-caps.json (enforcement) and credits are the display meter.
naming_note: Display names only. Internal ids (plan/gate/route/API) are stable until a scheduled revision.
